# Maxionlabs

> Maxionlabs books qualified first meetings with business owners for independent commercial insurance agencies and brokerages in the US (commercial P&C and employee benefits). The agency's own producers take the meetings and close.

## What it is
- Outbound prospecting run for the agency: we find owners of the businesses the agency already writes, using public-record triggers (new trucking authorities, contractor licences, OSHA records, Form 5500 plan years, liquor licences, permits and hiring), email them from our own domains, call every owner who says yes, check them against the agency's appetite, and book the meeting on the agency's calendar with a written brief.
- Qualified means: in the agency's territory and carrier appetite, above its premium or group-size floor, a need now or within 3 months, and the decision maker in the meeting.

## Price and terms
- 4,725 USD a month, month to month, paid upfront monthly. Prepay 3 months: 12,500 USD.
- 12 qualified appointments in month one, 15 a month after.
- 315 USD credit for each appointment short of the guarantee; unused credit refunded on cancellation. No-shows replaced.
- 7-day full refund for any reason after payment.
- Territory lock included: we do not book for another brokerage in the agency's counties. Appointments are never resold.

## Who it is for
- Independent commercial P&C or benefits agencies, roughly 2-15M USD revenue, with at least two producers besides the owner.
- Not for solo agents, in-person-only shops, personal-lines-led agencies or captive agents.
